verdict.summary: Simulated THM-01 (heatsink NTC) trip temperature is 84.99 degC and recovery temperature is 69.83 degC (uncalibrated), giving 15.16 degC of hysteresis. This is WITHIN the THM-01 85C trip / 70C recovery requirement (FUNCTIONAL_TEST_CRITERIA.md SS2.3), matching the ThermalComparator module's own inline hand-derivation (85.0C trip, 69.8C recovery) to within 0.01 degC / 0.03 degC.
